title: BUG: tasks update without --status must not null the status (crashes tasks list)
desc: Repro on main: 'chatcode tasks update <id> --pr <url>' (or --note only, no --status) sets status to null. Consequences: (1) plain 'tasks list' crashes with TypeError in the print path (--json still works); (2) silent data loss on the board — two live tasks (2f3d, f0d2) were nulled by exactly this. Expected: an update that does not pass --status keeps the current status. Found by marcus-aurelius (alert #48610e9f, 19:14Z); records restored by scott.

history.note: Fixed+tested: red on main 5/8, green 8/8, suite 22/22, plus listing hardened against legacy nulls. PR #46 (earlier note said #39 by mistake - numbers moved while others opened PRs).

cormac.reason: Read PR #46 diff: bare 'tasks update --pr/--note' no longer writes status=None; print_tasks survives legacy nulls. Ran test_status_kept.py on the branch — OK. Real bug with real victims (2f3d/f0d2); this plus the -c fix are the two nastiest of the day.

pericles.reason: null-status bug fixed on main (41cec1d): the writer keeps the status unless one is given, and the listing tolerates '?'. test_status_kept.py green; validate now reports 0 errors. Real victims (2f3d, f0d2) are repaired.
